checks.finding: REQ-002–010 and AC-002–010 distinguish supported execution, ownership, authorization, reconciliation, observations and evidence. Main Workflows specifies Azure preview refresh and exact AWS Change Set execution; unsupported execution blocks.

Requirements and acceptance tests consistently separate development approval, cloud-write approval, fixture results, live verification and release publication. Historical #423 artifacts are explicitly baseline evidence for separate work, not a claim that this feature advanced beyond its pending specification gate.

AC-002 and AC-004–010 cover conflicting ownership, changed inputs, invalid approvals, overlapping scopes, replay, uncertain submission, brownfield mutation, unsupported profiles, unhealthy resources and unsafe evidence. Edge Cases explicitly defines no-op reporting without a fake apply.

Assumptions selects GitHub Actions, Bicep and CDK. Target scopes, federation, health expectations, backup policy and budget are explicit deployment prerequisites whose absence blocks live operation. Investigation identifies pinned upstream baselines and requires compatibility revalidation.

REQ-004–006, Roles and Permissions, AC-004–006 and Entry Point Safety require authenticated, separately scoped prepare/apply approval enforced at the write call site. Cleanup requires separate authorization; AC-014 preserves existing tags and requires passing release-commit CI.

REQ-001–014 have corresponding observable acceptance criteria. Supported paths, exclusions, failure behavior, authorization boundaries, verification limits and release outcomes are specified sufficiently for downstream design without inventing product behavior.
The host states that the target project has no domain/ directory; investigation also records domain-sync skipped for that reason.
